item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.8

  • The deck can dock to the bottom of the screen: the notes lie along it as a row of tabs, each carrying its name, and a tab rises when you point at it (Settings › General › Screen side)
  • "Show over full-screen apps" now does something when it is switched off. The deck and your pinned notes used to sit on top of a full-screen app whichever way the switch was thrown; with it off they stay on your desktops and leave full screen alone
  • On a left-docked deck the start of every line is no longer clipped, and a tab carries its whole name instead of the first word
  • A note's text no longer flashes on a moment after the card has come to rest
  • A note's close dot and its neighbour are drawn at the size a real title bar uses, and the ring around the colour you have chosen is tucked in close instead of standing proud of the row
